title: Rope Experiment
description: Welcome to our Rope game! Tie the rope to dot-shaped needles, ensuring it touches them all. Challenge your skills in this puzzling adventure. Can you conquer every level? Get ready to knot, twist, and weave your way to victory!
instructions: How to Play Objective Connect all the dot-shaped needles by moving the rope with your mouse Mouse Controls Use your mouse to guide the rope Move the mouse to navigate the rope Click and hold to attach the rope to a needle Connect Needles Position
